preference_risk.rationale: “Operasi” is a plausible Malaysian medical alternative, particularly in informal or compound usage, although “pembedahan” is the usual standard preference.

response.rationale: “Operasi” is the ordinary Indonesian term for surgery, while Malaysian Malay generally prefers “pembedahan” for the same medical procedure. The contrast is useful, though “operasi” is also understandable in Malaysian usage.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian speakers may also use or understand “operasi” for surgery, so the national preference is not absolute.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Operasi” can occur in Malaysian Malay, especially in informal or compound medical usage, but “pembedahan” remains the clearer ordinary Malaysian preference; “pembedahan” is also understood in Indonesian without displacing “operasi”.
